submitted.rationale: Across 5 EQE measurements, Sb=0.195 (idx 1) gave the highest EQE (0.039%). Idx 0 at Sb=0.15 gave 0.023%, idx 4 at 0.32 gave 0.015%, idx 22 at 0.66 gave 0.010% and idx 14 at 0.50 gave 0.008%. The peak is on the Pb-rich side, near Sb≈0.2, likely a Pb-oxide/Pb2Sb2O7 mixed-phase region. MEGNet predicts a pyrochlore gap of about 2.5 eV, which lies below the 2.7 eV illumination.
